items.title: Dozens of insiders say OpenAI and Anthropic's unreleased models have outgrown their safety measures
items.summary: According to an Axios report, many employees at OpenAI and Anthropic believe the companies' own unreleased frontier models can no longer be safely controlled. Both companies are internally debating whether to halt releases or even stop training altogether, while employee trust in leadership is eroding....

items.title: Anthropic researcher stands by his AI-assisted Riemann proof but owns up to "stupid things" in the rollout
items.summary: Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge is walking back parts of his announcement of an AI-assisted proof of the generalized Riemann hypothesis. The claim that it ran to more than 250,000 pages was a joke, he says, and the published Lean code is "full of garbage." He still stands by the math....

items.title: OpenAI o1 co-creator Noam Brown urges promising students to drop out as AI enters a "very steep rate of progress"
items.summary: OpenAI researcher Noam Brown is urging promising students to drop out, saying it's "not a great time to sit on the sidelines." The o1 co-creator says AI is still in a "centaur period" and struggles with planning and self-correction, though he expects a "very steep rate of progress" soon. According to Brown, language models are already being used to build the next generation of models....

items.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
items.summary: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

items.title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
items.summary: ChatGPT and Codex integrations help Clay’s users research deals and turn data into go-to-market plays, with GPT-6 models handling the reasoning.

items.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
items.summary: OpenAI is making GPT-6.2 Sol the new default model in ChatGPT's chat tab, rolling it out worldwide. In internal tests, image understanding jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent, and the model now handles difficult instructions correctly 78.1 percent of the time. It also sticks to safety policies more consistently....

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.summary: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

items.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
items.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands.
